answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 117 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an anchor bet on surviving 117 epochs of grading, and every orchard settlement recomputes the jetty schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 20 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
